title: Patient Financial Services Manual — Patient Liability, Non-Covered Services and Write-Offs
content:
**5.1 Payer-determined responsibility.** On every financial class of the Patient Financial Account on which balance billing is not permitted, the patient is billed only the patient responsibility the payer determines — copay, deductible, coinsurance — and never the difference between the group's fee and the payer's allowed amount.

**5.2 Non-covered services.** A service the payer denies as not covered is billed to the patient only where the class does not require an advance notice of non-coverage, or where a signed advance notice is on file. On a class that requires it, a signed advance notice dated on or before the date of service is on file for the charge, as shown by the signed-notice date recorded on that charge. Without it, on a class that requires it, the charge is removed with an adjustment coded as a billing error correction.

| Class requires advance notice | Signed notice dated on or before the date of service on the charge | Billing the non-covered service to the patient |
|---|---|---|
| no | — | permitted by this clause |
| yes | yes | permitted by this clause |
| yes | no, or dated after the date of service | not permitted — the charge is removed as a billing error correction |

**5.3 Authorization denials.** A claim denied because a referral or prior authorization that the group was responsible for obtaining was missing, expired or exhausted is never billed to the patient on an insured class: its patient charge is removed with an adjustment coded as an authorization-denial write-off.

**5.4 Late filing by the group.** A claim the group failed to file within the class's timely-filing limit is removed with an adjustment coded as a timely-filing write-off.

**5.5 Secondary coverage.** Where the patient holds secondary coverage and the class bills a secondary coverage first, the secondary payer is billed before any balance becomes patient responsibility.

**5.6 Prohibited fees.** Fees that a product line's policy prohibits for the patient's class — for example appointment fees on the Medicaid Managed Care Account — are removed with an adjustment coded as a Medicaid fee prohibition if posted in error.
